Canada ramps up space surveillance and Arctic defense procurement. 🛰️

### Aerospace & Defence
The Department of National Defence advances the Polar Helicopter Project alongside a supplemental invitation for Commercial Satellite Imagery and Commercial Space Situational Awareness Observations closing March 31, 2027. Contractors must deliver high-resolution orbital tracking and optical data streams meeting strict Department of National Defence spatial accuracy thresholds. Enterprise suppliers should structure specialized subcontracting consortia to bid on upcoming multi-year surveillance and heavy-lift rotorcraft tenders.

### Trade Compliance & Anti-Dumping
The Canadian International Trade Tribunal formally initiated an expiry review concerning small power transformers imported from Chinese Taipei and Korea, operating under new SIMA page limits and formatting standards effective October 1, 2026. Submissions must strictly adhere to a 70-page limit for initial filings and 40-page limits for replies, utilizing 12-point typography within files under 100 MB to avoid immediate rejection by the Tribunal. Trade advisory firms can structure comprehensive market participation and injury-defense submissions for industry associations and foreign exporters navigating these SIMA expiry reviews.

### Transportation & Logistics
The Canadian Transportation Agency approved a fifth and seventh freedom charter flight connecting European origins directly to Canadian regional nodes, while opening new freight adjudication proceedings regarding railway noise and vibration compliance under Case Number 26-10158. Non-compliance with charter flight authorizations risks immediate groundings, civil penalties, and the revocation of landing rights by aviation authorities. Advisory practices can structure specialized aviation compliance retainers and rail-freight SLA renegotiation services for affected operators managing cross-border clearances.

### Federal Procurement & Professional Services
The Public Service Commission issued a specialized Task and Solutions Professional Services requirement for Professional Evaluation Services Consultants across National Capital Region evaluation workstreams. Contractors failing to maintain active Tier 1 Supply Arrangement standing face immediate exclusion from task authorization awards and forfeiture of multi-year advisory pipelines. Advisory practices can package proposal development and subcontractor alignment services to assist suppliers with contracting authority requests.

👉 Full dashboard with filters and strategic analysis: https://4mayAi.github.io/canadian-grant-intelligence/trade-compliance/
